speaker: (a tailor, shifting his bundle)
text: They are still at the quills. I have been a bundle in this passage since the hour.

speaker: (a trumpeter)
text: We were here before you. We shall be here after you. Hold the case still.

speaker: (the other trumpeter)
text: A clerk hears a trumpet through a door, and then he trims another quill. Leave it shut.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let him trim. When he looks up, I am the first name he sees.

speaker: (the clerk)
text: William Kempe, William Shakespeare and Richard Burbage, servants to the Lord Chamberlain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Those are the names.

speaker: (the clerk)
text: Dated the fifteenth of March, fifteen ninety-four.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Ninety-four. A year, sitting in his margin, while we stood in his passage.

speaker: will_kemp
text: He began where I wanted him to begin. I was listening for it.

speaker: (the clerk)
text: Twenty pound. Angels, and the silver after. The bag is here. The palace is not through that door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Count it. I would rather a number than a silence.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will carry it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Carry it. Thou hast the will, and the hands are free.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He looked at the three of us, and then he looked at the bag. I have been greeted more warmly for a worse play.

speaker: (the clerk)
text: The passage is how you leave. That door is not yours.

speaker: will_kemp
text: We did not ask the door. We asked the twenty.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The tide will have turned. I am not buying a boat against it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nor double oars. I will not pay a fare for going more slowly than my own feet. We walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Strand, and then Holborn. The bag stays shut until John has seen it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Shut, and in my hand.

speaker: (the tailor)
text: If you are walking, keep the middle of the Strand. The edge is mud, and twenty pound makes a man careless.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The middle, then.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: An hour of quills, a bag, and a walk. Come, before he finds a further form.

speaker: will_kemp
text: First out, as well. The trumpets can have the passage. They seem to live here.
